question: Build a large, high-quality, provenance-preserving reference library for modern editorial homepage design. Search beyond Storybook examples: Figma Community templates and design systems, previously supplied open-source design resources, maintained open-source editorial and magazine projects, modern independent magazines, cultural publications, art-book and newspaper-inspired sites, and strong non-SaaS web design references. Reuse all existing local reference material first, then expand externally. Record source URL, author/project, license or usage status, maintenance/currentness, visual traits, interaction patterns, typography, grid, image treatment, navigation, fit for Westside Watch, and rejection reason. Cluster the library into distinct design directions and only then create Storybook experiments. Do not stop after one search, one source, one build, or one successful component.
failure_fingerprint: REFERENCE_LIBRARY_TOO_SMALL: current Storybook search and template search are insufficient and produce near-identical micro-variants rather than a homepage redesign.

required_outputs: at least three materially different Storybook homepage directions
acceptance.completion_rule: Keep goal active until all thresholds are met and the three directions are visually and structurally distinct.
